const MISSIONS=[

const DISC_SCORES=[0,10,15,25,35,50,50];
const VALUES_OPTIONS=[{pts:20,lbl:"Inicial"},{pts:40,lbl:"Em desenvolvimento"},{pts:60,lbl:"Plenamente demonstrado"}];
let state={}, discsRemaining=6, valuesScore=40, inspBonus=false;

function initState(){MISSIONS.forEach(m=>m.items.forEach(it=>{if(it.type==='counter')state[it.key]=0;else if(it.type==='toggle'||it.type==='danger-toggle')state[it.key]=false;}));}
function isLocked(it){return it.requires&&!it.requires();}
function cascadeOff(key){MISSIONS.forEach(m=>m.items.forEach(it=>{if(it.type==='toggle'&&it.requires&&isLocked(it)&&state[it.key]){state[it.key]=false;cascadeOff(it.key);}}));}
function getMissionScore(m){
  if(m.zeroable&&state['m8_derrubou'])return 0;
  let s=0;m.items.forEach(it=>{if(it.type==='counter')s+=state[it.key]*it.pts;else if(it.type==='toggle'&&state[it.key]&&!isLocked(it))s+=it.pts;});return s;
}
function isZeroed(m){return m.zeroable&&state['m8_derrubou'];}
function calcTotal(){
  let missions=0;MISSIONS.forEach(m=>missions+=getMissionScore(m));
  return{missions,discs:DISC_SCORES[discsRemaining],vals:valuesScore,insp:inspBonus?20:0,
         total:missions+DISC_SCORES[discsRemaining]+valuesScore+(inspBonus?20:0)};
}
